files.scripts/build-ios.sh:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
echo "[1/4] Installing dependencies & building shared dist..."
npm install
npm run build:web
echo "[2/4] Initializing & syncing Capacitor iOS project..."
if [ ! -d "ios/App/App.xcodeproj" ] && [ ! -d "ios/App/App.xcworkspace" ]; then
  npx cap add ios
fi
npx cap sync ios
echo "[3/4] Installing CocoaPods..."
if [ -f "ios/App/Podfile" ]; then
  (cd ios/App && pod install)
fi
echo "[4/4] Archiving iOS App via xcodebuild..."
xcodebuild -workspace ios/App/App.xcworkspace -scheme App -configuration Release -sdk iphoneos -archivePath build/zulutronix-omni-os.xcarchive archive CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO
echo "iOS XCArchive generated at build/zulutronix-omni-os.xcarchive (export .ipa using ios/ExportOptions.plist)"

files..github/workflows/rea-multiplatform-rele:
name: R.E.A Multi-Platform End-to-End Build (ZULUTRONIX Omni-OS)

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  build-web:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
      - run: npm install && npm run build:web
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: zulutronix-omni-os-web-pwa
          path: dist/

  build-windows:
    runs-on: windows-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
      - run: npm install && npm run build:windows
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: zulutronix-omni-os-windows-installer
          path: src-tauri/target/x86_64-pc-windows-msvc/release/bundle/

  build-macos:
    runs-on: macos-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
        with:
          targets: aarch64-apple-darwin,x86_64-apple-darwin
      - run: bash scripts/build-macos.sh
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: zulutronix-omni-os-macos-universal-dmg
          path: src-tauri/target/universal-apple-darwin/release/bundle/

  build-ios:
    runs-on: macos-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
      - run: bash scripts/build-ios.sh
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: zulutronix-omni-os-ios-xcarchive
          path: build/zulutronix-omni-os.xcarchive

  build-android:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
      - uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: '17'
      - run: bash scripts/build-android.sh
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: zulutronix-omni-os-android-apk-aab
          path: android/app/build/outputs/
files.README.md:
# ZULUTRONIX Omni-OS

> Forged end-to-end by **B.A.R.B.I R.E.A Agent Forge** integrated with **morluto/rea** (https://github.com/morluto/rea).

Unified Cross-Platform Robotics Telemetry, Edge Control & REA MCP Diagnostics

## Target Platforms Included
- **Web App & PWA** (`Live Hosted SPA + Express API + Service Worker`) — `npm install && npm run build:web && npm start`
- **Windows Native** (`Tauri v2 x64 Installer (.exe NSIS + .msi) + Edge App Launcher`) — `powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/build-windows.ps1`
- **macOS Native** (`Universal Apple Silicon + Intel (.dmg & .app)`) — `bash scripts/build-macos.sh`
- **iOS Native** (`Capacitor Xcode Project + XCArchive / .ipa Export`) — `bash scripts/build-ios.sh`
- **Android Native** (`Capacitor Gradle Project (.apk + Play Store .aab)`) — `bash scripts/build-android.sh`

## REA GitHub Repo MCP Setup
```bash
npx rea-agents@latest setup
```

The `.rea/rea-mcp.json` file configures the `rea-agents@latest` MCP server for automated inspection, reverse-engineering verification, and rebuild workflows.

## Automated Multi-OS Release Pipeline
Push this repository to GitHub to run `.github/workflows/rea-multiplatform-release.yml`, which builds artifacts for all selected platforms (web, windows, macos, ios, android).
